recentItems.title: SIG Sauer’s next-gen firepower unleashed - did we just fire the SA80’s successor?
recentItems.description:
What options might SIG Sauer put forward to replace the UK Armed Forces main service rifle? 🇬🇧
 
BFBS Forces News gets rare access to the US Army’s Next Generation Squad Weapon, the M8 – becoming the first UK broadcaster to fire it.
 
The M8 is one of several rifles that might end up being in the running to replace the SA80 under Project Grayburn, a programme that will shape the British soldier’s main rifle for decades to come.
 
We head to the range to fire the 516 G3, 300 BLACKOUT MCX LT, M7, M8, we get hands-on with the SIG MCX used by the Royal Marines, and we see a demo of SIG’s hybrid ammunition against body armour.
 
We also go behind the scenes at SIG Sauer’s manufacturing operation to find out how quickly it could produce thousands of rifles – and whether the company would manufacture in the UK.
 
But with the MOD still deciding exactly what it wants from Project Grayburn, one big question remains:
 
Will the UK choose something similar to what is has now– or will it opt for a completely new approach?
 
Watch as we explore the technology, firepower and manufacturing behind what could be one of the contenders to replace the SA80.

Presenters:
Sian Grzeszczyk Melbourne
Justin Bosanquet
 
Camera:
Hannah King
 
Graphics:
Fred Ford
